lines.text: Zeek's hand tightened around the strap of his satchel.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: My father surveyed irrigation channels, burial chambers, collapsed foundations, and whatever else people were foolish enough to build over unstable ground. He was never appointed to anything called a lower threshold.

lines.speaker: Zik

lines.speaker: Narrator

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: It means BAYL-ID-din spent the rest of his life trying to keep you away from that tomb.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sound never reached his throat.

lines.text: He believed distance would not be enough.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: He believed knowledge might teach you caution.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: That suggests he did not know me very well.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: He knew you better than you think.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: Then he should have known caution works poorly when paired with secrets.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Collector's fingers touched the outside of the shutter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek saw their shadows through the narrow gap between the boards.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: He altered records. He paid men to forget routes. He moved objects from one collection to another. He convinced a priesthood that a damaged seal belonged in a provincial storehouse where no one would bother cataloguing it for three generations.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun's mouth tightened at the insult to cataloguing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: That question is older than your profession.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: My profession is older than most kingdoms.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: That is what archivists say whenever they want to make dust sound important.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun stepped closer to the shutter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo caught the back of her robe.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: I only want to see his face.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: That has killed better people than you.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: My father knew the seventh drawer named me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek moved closer to the shutter until his breath touched the wood.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: The date appeared after KOO-rash died.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: It is the only one you are trying not to say.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: So was the journal. That hasn't prevented it from writing new sentences.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark in Zeek's palm pulsed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For a moment, the Collector's fingers on the other side of the shutter flexed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: I have seen many things that should have remained impossible.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: What did it write for you?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rain struck the shutter where they had been.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: When the Collector answered, his voice had moved slightly to the left.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.note: Whispered.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg stepped toward the wall beside the window, preparing to strike through the shutter if the Collector tried to open it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek did not take his eyes from the dark line between the boards.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Now the journal has drawn you a road back.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: And you sent a scribe to tell me not to follow it.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: I sent a scribe because approaching you directly would have been noticed.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: That is not a useful question.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: The useful question is why you believed the man was mine.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Collector's voice seemed to recede another finger's breadth from the shutter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: The message? The mention of the mark?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek remembered the young man's face changing at the mouth of the alley.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sudden age in his eyes.

lines.speaker: False Scribe
lines.text: Some doors are sealed because the thing behind them is still waiting.
lines.note: Memory echo of the false scribe's last line. Nervousness gone; suddenly older. Slower, calmer, lower.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: I hoped you might tell me.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Most thieves use something that belongs to another man.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo moved closer to the shutter.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: He looked like a temple scribe.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: He also had a knife against his side.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Apparently that did not inconvenience him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Collector gave a faint sound through the wood.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The blade passed between the boards and stopped.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: You are standing farther away than you sound,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: she said to no one in particular.
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: That may be the safest conclusion we have reached,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek kept his attention on the alley.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Because you are leaving through the lime-kiln breach.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo's second knife appeared in her other hand.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun folded BAYL-ID-din's warning once more.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: It is the exit BAYL-ID-din used.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: I never told my father about it.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: He knew the city before you learned to steal from it.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: I do not steal from cities.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: You have made a profession of removing their contents.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: History is unattended property to you.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: History is property to everyone. I am simply less dishonest about the transfer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Collector did not answer him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: The useful question is whether the watcher expects to be seen.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: You know where we are, what route we planned to take, what we found in the archive, and what my father broke twenty years ago.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Your confidence in me is touching.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: But you do not know who is watching a hole in a wall.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: A man who claims to know everything is selling religion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Something scraped softly beneath the shutter.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Every weapon in the room shifted toward the sound.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A small object slid through the gap and fell onto the floor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It struck the plaster once, turned on its edge, and settled.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg placed one foot over it before anyone else moved.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: It weighs less than a date.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Your life has been badly organized.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He crouched without lowering his axe and picked it up between two fingers.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It was no larger than the first joint of his thumb, darkened with age and worn smooth around the rim. Seven narrow lines descended along its face.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They did not meet at the center.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The center had been left empty.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg held it toward the roof vent.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun came closer despite en-HEH-doo's hand on her sleeve.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The reverse bore a shallow pattern of nested angles. At first they looked decorative. Then Zeek saw that each angle corresponded to a turn in the descending route drawn by the journal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun saw it at the same moment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: It tells the door what stands before it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg held the seal farther from himself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: A mistake I have carried for twenty years.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: What did you use it on?

lines.text: The room lost what little warmth it had retained.

lines.text: BAH-lahg's gaze went to the warning page in Ninsun's hand.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: That is not an archaeological description.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: It is the only accurate one.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Not in the way I intended.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Place the seal against the lower door. Not the black floor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun took the seal from BAH-lahg and studied the edges.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: There is residue in the cuts.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She paused with one fingernail already against the bronze.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Because some of it is mine.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: I dislike the object now as well.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.text: Zeek pressed closer to the shutter.

lines.speaker: The Collector
lines.text: Because BAYL-ID-din took the other one.

lines.text: He carried it into the tomb.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek felt the journal move again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A slow tightening against the satchel's leather, as though it had heard something it wanted.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: My father returned from the tomb.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rainwater ran beneath the shutter and formed a narrow crescent on the floor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: That is not the same thing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Collector's footsteps began to recede.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He pulled free and shoved the wooden panel outward.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rain silvered the stones. Water dripped from the awnings. A dog stood beneath a stairway at the far end, watching him with the offended expression of an animal disturbed during private business.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No robes disappearing around the corner.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No ripples in the puddles except those made by rain.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The wall opposite the room bore a line of wet handprints.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They climbed the wall vertically until they reached the roofline.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: He did not leave through the alley.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun came to the window with the bronze seal in her palm.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The handprints ended at the roof.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No marks led across the tiles.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg stepped back from the shutter.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: I dislike him more than before.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: That still may be the safest conclusion we have reached.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun placed the bronze seal on the table.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rainwater had gathered along the grooves.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It did not spill when she tilted it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The droplets clung inside the seven lines, each one held in place as though the metal had become a tiny descending channel.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: The map draws itself inside a book made from a dead man.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: You continue saying things as though they support your position.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The metal was colder than the room.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The instant it touched his marked palm, heat ran through his wrist.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The seven lines on the bronze darkened.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One after another, from the rim toward the empty center.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: That is becoming your most destructive habit.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark beneath Zeek's skin answered with a pulse.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For one breath, the empty center of the seal reflected a room that was not theirs.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Beyond it, something pale moved out of sight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then the bronze showed only bronze again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek closed his fingers around it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: That was already implied by the conversation.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg tightened the rope around one of the packs.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Then we should leave before whatever opened it reaches the stairs.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg divided the weight among them with the authority of a man who expected everyone else to make poor decisions if given a choice. He tied one rope across his chest and another beneath his pack. The hammer went at his side, wrapped in cloth so it would not strike the chisels while they moved.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun secured her tablets between folded robes and wrapped the wet clay strip in linen.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Not if you stop sitting on my records.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo checked the room for anything they had touched.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She wiped the table, the wall cavity, the shutter latch, and the roof edge with a strip of damp cloth.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek wrapped the journal twice and placed it at the bottom of his satchel.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The leather knocked once against his palm as he lowered it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He put the bronze seal into a separate pouch and tied it around his neck. The metal rested against his chest, colder than the rain.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: He wrote it because he knew KOO-rash would not listen to him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun saw and softened her voice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The papyrus was thin where BAYL-ID-din's stylus had pressed too hard beneath KOO-rash's name.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He folded it and placed it beside the seal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They left through the roof rather than the door.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo went first, lowering herself onto the adjoining tiles. Ninsun followed with BAH-lahg's hand around her forearm. Zeek passed the packs across one at a time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: When BAH-lahg climbed out last, the room behind them remained dark.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The shutter shifted inward after he released it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: I am tired of being the only one who sees impossible things.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The rain stopped while they moved through the western quarter. Clouds covered the moon, and water streamed from the buildings into the lanes below.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They descended behind a dyer's workshop.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The vats had been covered for the night, but the air still smelled of indigo, lye, and wet wool. Zeek landed beside a stack of clay jars and caught one before it tipped.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun descended with less elegance and more commentary.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg came last, dislodging a section of reed matting that struck him across the shoulders.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: The city objects to my shape.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Uruk had emptied to guards, late porters, and dogs searching the gutters. A line of temple laborers crossed ahead carrying covered baskets between them. None looked toward Zeek's group.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They kept to the narrow lanes.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At every junction, en-HEH-doo moved ahead, listened, then signaled them through. Once she stopped so suddenly that Ninsun walked into BAH-lahg's back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Two guards stood beneath an awning twenty paces ahead.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The other had a tablet tucked beneath his arm.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek looked at the silver seal fixed to its edge.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The same seal the false scribe had carried.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark in his palm began to itch.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo drew them into the doorway of a closed grain shop.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rainwater dripped from the lamp guard's helmet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The distance was too great for him to see through the darkness.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Still, his face aligned exactly with the doorway.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The journal pressed against Zeek's back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo pulled Zeek deeper into the recess.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Their sandals passed the entrance without slowing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg waited until the sound faded.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: He said he did not send the scribe.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek looked at the wet street where the guards had vanished.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: Because they wanted me to know they had seen me.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Then we should assume the breach is watched.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: We discussed it. Assumption requires discipline.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Do you understand why she annoys me?

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Both of you are carrying my water.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The old lime kilns stood abandoned near the city wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Their collapsed mouths opened from the ground like broken ovens. Rain had turned the ash around them into pale mud that clung to sandals and gave off a bitter mineral smell.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The city wall rose behind them, black against the clouded sky.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek led the others between two ruined firing chambers and stopped beneath the remains of a brick arch.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No false temple scribe standing politely in the rain.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo crouched and touched the mud.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She moved two fingers along a shallow impression.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: One person stood here for some time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The thorn brush concealing the drainage channel had been replaced.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He knew because the longest branch usually pointed toward the wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: The nearest is beneath a tannery.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo examined the brush without touching it.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: No cord. No bell. No blade.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: I was beginning to like you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mud at its edge held a single clean impression.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Seven narrow lines around an empty center.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The same pattern as the seal hanging beneath his robe.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark in his palm pulsed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The impression softened immediately, collapsing into featureless mud.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek pulled the thorn brush aside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The drainage channel gaped beneath it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They lowered the packs through first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo entered on her stomach and vanished into the dark.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun followed, pushing her satchel ahead of her.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage smelled of wet ash and stagnant water. Cold air moved through it from beyond the wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg looked at the opening, then at his own shoulders.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: That would have been useful information.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Mud soaked through his sleeves immediately.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The ceiling pressed close above his back. Water ran around his hands and pooled beneath his knees. Ahead, Ninsun's sandals disappeared around a bend in the drain.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Behind him, BAH-lahg dragged the thorn brush back across the opening.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They moved on hands and knees beneath the city wall, pushing their equipment ahead.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Every sound enlarged inside the channel.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The soft knock of a waterskin against stone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek felt the journal shift whenever his pack struck the ceiling.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: From somewhere beneath them came a faint answering knock.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun looked back over her shoulder.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: There is another channel below us.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: The old drainage plans show only this one.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: You trust the city records now?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Another knock came from beneath the floor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg pressed one palm to the brick.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The channel narrowed near the center of the wall. BAH-lahg's pack scraped both sides at once. He cursed, twisted, and forced himself through by exhaling until his chest flattened enough to pass.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek's fingers struck something hard in the mud.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He held it near the tiny glow of Ninsun's covered lamp.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A fourth had been added beneath them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The same message they had found in the wall cavity.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The water carried it backward toward BAH-lahg.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The clay fragment stopped moving against the current.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At the far end, cold air touched Zeek's face.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun pushed her pack toward the opening, and en-HEH-doo pulled it through. Then Ninsun disappeared after it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek crawled the last few cubits.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo hauled him onto damp earth beyond Uruk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The air outside the walls felt wider and colder. The desert smelled of wet dust, thorn, and distant salt.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg forced himself through the opening with a curse that continued long after his shoulders were free. He stood, brushing mud from his robe and beard.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Behind them, the city wall rose black against the clouded sky.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A line of torches moved along its upper walkway.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ahead, the desert stretched beyond the reach of their covered lamps.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun checked the clay tablets before checking herself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg tightened the rope across his chest.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Whatever had answered beneath Uruk had not answered again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He looked back at the wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For an instant, a figure stood atop it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then the flames guttered, and the figure was gone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg looked toward the unseen tomb.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: en-HEH-doo adjusted the knife at her belt.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek touched the bronze seal beneath his robe.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The seven lines felt warm now.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: We find out how deep my father was wrong.
